HapHuyet.name: Hấp Huyết
HapHuyet.target_requirements: Living blood-bearing, successfully hit by melee sword attack, positive actual post-defense HP damage
HapHuyet.weapon_independence: Huyết Nha +3 retains independent +7 BLOOD on eligible ordinary landed strikes, NOT sword-skill strikes; Hấp Huyết does not directly restore BLOOD

NgamBanOnDinh.name: Ngắm Bắn Ổn Định
NgamBanOnDinh.effect: After movement <=3m, complete stop, and valid aimed bow/crossbow shot, reduce by up to 15 percentage points ONLY actual hit penalty caused by preceding movement, not below zero; this replaces Lv1 10pp, does not add.
NgamBanOnDinh.requires: Full stop/stable stance and normal aimed shot; standard action and reload constraints remain
does_not_apply: other penalties such as cover, range or wind
NgamBanOnDinh.not_bonus: Not a flat accuracy bonus, auto hit, extra attack or extra action
NgamBanOnDinh.verified_training: T164 foundation 2/3; T165 first failed 2/5 bow and 3/5 crossbow then corrected and passed 4/5 EACH at ~12m after short repositioning
NgamBanOnDinh.verification: Maela T169 separate 8/10 legal hits with bow and 8/10 with Liên Nỏ after unpredictable <=3m steps, full stops and valid reload, following coached technical practice; not guaranteed.
NgamBanOnDinh.nonstacking: Lv2 replaces Lv1 not additive; does not double-apply same penalty with Phối Hợp Kiếm–Nỏ (which addresses distinct switch-only penalty).

PhoiHopKiemNo.name: Phối Hợp Kiếm–Nỏ
PhoiHopKiemNo.valid_transition: Legally completed sword sheathing -> Liên Nỏ Hắc Nha switching and properly loaded/ready for normally timed aimed shot
PhoiHopKiemNo.effect: Reduce only the hit penalty due to legal sword-to-crossbow weapon switching, up to 5 percentage points, never below zero; apply on immediately following valid aimed shot.
does_not_apply: Free attack or shot out of turn
Damage bonus or reload speed bonus
PhoiHopKiemNo.stacking_guard: Ngắm Bắn Ổn Định may separately reduce up to 10 percentage points of actual movement-induced hit penalty only after <=3m move+full stop. Do not subtract both from same source penalty.
PhoiHopKiemNo.verified_training: Maela certified 4/5 valid multibeat sequences at T167, after 3/5 not passing in T166; maintained cooldown and reload discipline.

Chuyển Mạch: safely redirect through 3 turning posts, regulate BLOOD and balance
Thu Kiếm: close to wooden dummy, execute single slash, recover guard and terminate surge
